description: This Java class 'DOMSettingsBuilder' constructs and serializes XML configuration files for application settings, including window, file, options, display, logger, clipboard format, and icon settings.

classes.name: DOMSettingsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for building and serializing application settings into an XML format.

methods.name: buildSettings
methods.description: Constructs an XML document representing various application settings and writes it to a specified output file.

methods.name: buildWindow
methods.description: Creates an XML node with window-related settings such as size, position, and maximized state.

methods.name: buildFiles
methods.description: Creates an XML node with file-related settings including image directory, repository directory, and ECU definition files.

methods.name: buildOptions
methods.description: Creates an XML node with various application options and preferences.

methods.name: buildTableDisplay
methods.description: Creates an XML node with table display settings such as font, cell size, and colors.

methods.name: buildLogger
methods.description: Creates an XML node with logger configuration settings including connection, window, and plugin details.

methods.name: buildTableClipboardFormat
methods.description: Creates an XML node defining clipboard format settings for tables.

methods.name: buildIcons
methods.description: Creates an XML node with icon scale settings for editor and table icons.
